name: ParentElement
label: Parent Element
description: The parent UI element under which to search for the collection.

name: PropertyType
label: Property Type
description: The property type to search by (e.g., Name, AutomationId, ClassName, ControlType).

selectOptions.label: Class Name
selectOptions.description: Find element by its class name.

selectOptions.label: ID
selectOptions.description: Find element by its automation ID.

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Find element by its visible name.

selectOptions.label: Control Type
selectOptions.description: Find element by its control type (e.g., button, textbox).

name: PropertyValue
label: Property Value
description: The value of the property to match for the collection.

name: ElementName
label: Element Name
description: The name of the element to match within the collection.

name: NameMatchType
label: Name Match Type
description: How to match the element name: Equals or Contains.

selectOptions.label: Contains
selectOptions.description: Match element name if it contains the specified value.

name: ClickType
label: Click Type
description: How to click the element: UI Automation Click or Mouse Click.

selectOptions.label: Mouse Click
selectOptions.description: Click using mouse at the element's clickable point.

name: MaxWaitTime
label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
description: Maximum time to wait for the element and click action (in seconds).

name: WasClicked
label: Was Clicked
description: True if the element was clicked successfully, otherwise false.
